offering_description.value: Provides hydraulic fracturing and related well completion services to oil and gas exploration and production companies in US shale basins. Operates large fleets of frac pumping equipment and manufactures much of its own equipment. Also mines and sells proppant (sand) and supplies other completion-related products.

primary_products.value: proppant (frac sand); hydraulic fracturing pumps and equipment; completion chemicals

primary_services.value: hydraulic fracturing; well completion services; wireline; cementing

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas exploration and production operators, including large independents

end_markets.value: oil and gas exploration and production; oilfield services

revenue_model.value: service fees: fracturing and completion services priced per job or under dedicated fleet contracts; product sales: proppant and equipment sold to operators and other service companies

value_chain_position.value: service provider: deploys frac fleets and crews for E&P operators; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures pumps and fleet components, mostly for own use; raw materials: mines proppant sand from own mines for sale to operators
value_chain_position.category: service provider; OEM / manufacturer; raw materials

geography_served.value: US national: Permian, Appalachia, Haynesville, Eagle Ford, Bakken and other US shale basins

specialization.value: related lines: fracturing services, proppant production, equipment manufacturing and other completion services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sold directly to E&P operators under dedicated fleet contracts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, water use, air emissions, silica and workplace safety rules from EPA, OSHA, MSHA and state oil and gas regulators

notes: Segment mix and which lines (e.g., other businesses) are still held is uncertain; details from memory.
